'''Matiby Silcap''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Major/Legends|major]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of the Imperial [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Rebel troops inside [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
